prerequisite_gate: Stage 2+ experiments in Colab GPU start ONLY after Stage 1 (CyberSec 30-step pilot) completes on Colab GPU and passes blind rubric comparison (Base vs Previous 268-step Adapter vs New Candidate).

1_tools_function_calling.license_note: Verify dataset card license (CC-BY-4.0 / Apache-2.0) and filter out non-schema records before training.
evaluation_criteria: Exact tool name and JSON schema validity
Handling of permission denials (ASK / DENY / T2 / T3)
Immediate halt when STOP flag is active
Post-call verification (never claim tool succeeded when ToolResult.ok == False)

primary_sources: Verified Bossman/SwapMe bugfixes with unit tests (G1-G7 studio/harness guards)

auxiliary_benchmark.name: SWE-bench Verified
auxiliary_benchmark.role: Auxiliary general Python issue-resolution check ONLY; explicitly NOT proof of Roblox/Luau quality.

3_memory_evaluation_first.rule: Measure Bossman's native memory BEFORE any weight changes; writing text to memory is NOT weight training.
benchmarks: Bossman native memory suite: exact date retrieval, fact update/supersession, source citation, and explicit abstention when facts are absent

4_computer_control.architecture_constraint: Qwen/Qwen3-32B is a TEXT-ONLY model and does NOT natively perceive screenshots. Computer control requires either a genuine multimodal VLM (e.g. Qwen2.5-VL / Qwen3-VL) or Bossman's verified local vision/OCR bridge (bcc/features/chat_vision.py + xiaomi-ocr-0:bf16) feeding structured UI state to the planner inside an isolated sandbox.
